## Goal
For EVERY file in the list below under `/home/jorap/Documents/GitHub/jorap.com/content/english/notes/`, ensure at least ONE of the two `examples:` lines carries a quiet earned gladness beat. Prefer editing the first example when both lack it.

## What gratitude looks like (NOT theater)
Good (from skill): friction + keep
- "I almost trusted memory - glad the wristband caught the play tweak before locker-room noise ate it."
- Faith: gift-shaped thanks when about grace ("Grace already settled standing - I obey from thanks...")
- Lesson keep: "glad the mess taught X" / "glad rollback saved Sunday"

BAD (never write):
- "I am so grateful for this principle..."
- Curtain-call blessings
- Padding every field with "thankful"
- Changing description to force thanks

## Rules (garden-voice)
- ONLY edit `examples` (and only if a shareable_thought payoff is complaint-only AND easy, leave shareable alone unless needed)
- Keep exactly two examples, one sentence each
- Scenes must still feel different
- No contractions in frontmatter (don't, it's, I'm → do not, it is, I am) — BUT "glad" sentences can use "I" ; avoid don't/it's/I'm/we're
- No em dashes (—); use hyphen (-) or comma
- No emoji
- Do NOT change key_concept, description, levels, cards, relationships unless required for consistency with an example you changed
- Faith lane: straight tone, no dry humor in verse glosses; do not invent doctrine
- Prefer "glad X held/caught/saved/taught" over "grateful for the principle"
- Keep JoRap voice: specific scenes (gym, jeepney, deploy, kid, kitchen) when already present - do not force Philippines color
